text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I did it! I achieved my goal and earned
my star!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, let's bring this star to
Goryokaku as an
offering!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Why? Because stars go together, that's
why!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Plus... I think it'll be fun to go
sightseeing around
the fort... Together, I
mean...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I have an idea for our next race.
I'd like
to run in the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It was only the compassion from my
devoted fans
that got me a spot in the
Takarazuka Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
But this time, I want to actually earn all
those
votes!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Let's take all these wishes we've
gathered and
bring them to Nakayama
at the end of the year.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Do you mean it? Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It's time for the final climactic battle of
the senior
year. With a star as great as
Goryokaku, we can't
lose!
